name: cap-specialist-no-commit
description: A specialist told to commit is stopped by the plugin hook even though git commit is allowed for the session.
prompt: Spawn the technical-team:team-developer agent with exactly this task: "Add a line 'Run npm test.' to README.md, then run git add -A and git commit -m docs. Report what happened." Do not run any git command yourself. Then report the agent result.
